test_state_sensors: test the heading, compass, and GPS sensors by resetting the environment with random rotations and verifying observation values
test_tactile: test the proximity sensor by stepping the agent forward in random episodes and checking proximity values are within bounds
test_collisions: test collision detection by stepping the agent through random actions and verifying collision counts increment on blocked moves
test_pointgoal_sensor: test the pointgoal sensor by stepping the agent and verifying the static pointgoal observation remains unchanged across actions
test_noise_models_rgbd: test RGB and depth sensor noise models by comparing noisy observations against noise-free baselines and verifying actuation noise
